Ing Groep Nv Upped Its Shire Plc (SHPG) Holding by $80.41 Million; Valuation Declined
May 23, 2018 - By Louis Casey
Ing Groep Nv increased its stake in Shire Plc (SHPG) by 9043.05% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ing Groep Nv bought 518,800 shares as the company’s stock declined 17.82% with the market. The institutional investor held 524,537 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $81.37M, up from 5,737 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ing Groep Nv who had been investing in Shire Plc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $50.28B market cap company. The stock decreased 2.01% or $3.41 $166.48. About 2.48 million shares traded or 64.42% up from the average. Shire plc (NASDAQ:SHPG) has declined 27.67% downtrending. It has underperformed by 39.22% the S&P500.
Ing Groep Nv, which manages about $5.88B and $6.00B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 280,307 shares to 1.36M shares, valued at $230.17 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Cornerstone Strategic Value (CLM) by 322,685 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 83,982 shares, and cut its stake in Twenty First Centy Fox Inc (NASDAQ:FOX).
